transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?
I’ve been taking on way too many projects at once and can’t seem to slow myself down at work or at home. It just feels like I'm constantly running on high gear and I can't find a way to stop.
Have you ever had a period lasting at least several days when you felt very down or lost interest in things much more than usual? Or has it only been times of feeling unusually energized and driven?

I haven't really experienced those low periods or felt down like that at all. It has mostly just been this recent time of feeling extremely energized, driven, and completely unable to slow myself down.

Before this recent high-energy period, have you had problems with attention, restlessness, or impulsivity since childhood, or is this a clear change from your usual self that started only recently? Have you also needed much less sleep than usual during this time and still felt full of energy?

This is a very clear change for me, as I'm normally quite disciplined and have never had these issues since childhood; it all just started about a month ago. And yes, I’ve been sleeping much less than usual, but I still wake up feeling like I've been shot out of a cannon, completely revved up and driven.

At any time in your life before this high-energy period, have you ever had a distinct episode lasting at least two weeks when you felt depressed, empty, or lost interest in most things? Or has it truly only ever been episodes of unusually high energy like this?

No, I’ve never really experienced periods of feeling deeply depressed, empty, or losing interest in things for weeks at a time in the past. My struggle has truly just been this current, overwhelming high-energy period where I can't seem to slow myself down.

During this past month, have you also felt unusually euphoric or irritable, talked much more than usual, or had racing thoughts—and has this caused serious problems like risky behavior, major trouble at work, or needing hospitalization?

Yes, I swing from feeling like a visionary on top of the world to snapping at my team with white-hot anger, all while talking nonstop because my thoughts are racing. It’s caused huge problems: I've been driving recklessly, ran up massive credit card debt for unapproved work events, and my wife is absolutely furious. Because of all this, HR recently pulled me off my flagship project because my team doesn't trust me anymore.

opening_question.question: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient describes a distinct 1-month episode of abnormally elevated and irritable mood with markedly increased energy, decreased need for sleep, pressured speech, racing thoughts, excessive goal-directed activity, and severe functional consequences including reckless driving, major overspending, and removal from a key work role. There is no history of depressive episodes, and the presentation is a clear recent change rather than a lifelong attentional pattern. This is most consistent with a manic episode without psychotic symptoms.
